paragraphs.notes: Markush enumeration table, compound numbers 423 to 435, continued from the preceding page: the page carries no Tabelle caption and no scaffold drawing, only the four-column header row and the rows. The cells are compound numbers and chemical symbols, not German prose, so zh and en are the same string; the only German on the page is the column heading Physikalische Daten (Physical data). Subscripts are printed as true subscripts (CH2CH2, O(CH2)2, OCH2CH=CH2) and R1 is printed as R with a superscript 1; both are flattened to plain text here. Every Physikalische Daten cell on this page is empty, so each row is transcribed with a trailing empty fourth cell after the final separator. The L column changes value mid-table: rows 423 to 426 are CH2CH2, rows 427 to 435 are CHMe. The R1 cells of rows 430 and 431 hold a drawn ring instead of text; each is recorded in drawings and referenced from the cell. A small ink speck sits in the Physikalische Daten cell of row 424 and a fainter one just right of the 424 in its Nr. cell; these are scan artifacts, not characters. No abbreviation key is printed on this page, so c-Bu, c-Pentyl, c-Hexyl, i-Pr, Me and Et are transcribed as printed and not expanded. The page body below the table is blank.

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st drawing on the page: inside the R1 cell of row Nr. 430
structures.core: tetrahydrofuran (oxolane), a saturated five-membered ring with one ring oxygen, drawn with the O at the bottom of the ring
substituents: CH2 at the ring carbon adjacent to the ring oxygen (C2 of the oxolane), drawn as a bond from that ring vertex down-left to a plain CH2 vertex
O attached to that exocyclic CH2, drawn up-left of it as a labelled O with a free valence: that free bond is the attachment point of the whole fragment to the scaffold
no other substituent drawn on the ring; the remaining three ring vertices are plain CH2
structures.name: (tetrahydrofuran-2-yl)methoxy

drawings.notes: Belongs to table row Nr. 430; it is that row's R1 value, drawn instead of written. The ring is drawn flat with no wedge or hash, so the configuration at C2 is not specified by the drawing. smiles is null because the fragment as drawn has an open valence at the attachment oxygen and no attachment-point notation is used elsewhere in this run; writing OCC1CCCO1 would assert a hydroxyl the drawing does not show. Recorded as intermediate_structure because it is a Markush substituent value in an enumeration table, not a step of any route; nothing on this page is presented as prior art.
